archetype.name: Lead Bioinformatics Scientist / Clinical Genomics
archetype.recommended_summary: Bioinformatics Lead Scientist with 10+ years of experience in precision medicine across oncology and rare diseases. Expert in designing, building, and productionizing end-to-end applied bioinformatics and multi-omics pipelines for clinical workflows. Conceived and built comprehensive cross-functional bioinformatics stacks from scratch, delivering reproducible, scalable, and regulatory-ready solutions that integrate NGS analysis, clinical variant interpretation, phenotype-based prioritization, and data-driven insights. Active builder of AI-powered tools spanning multi-agent systems, clinical AI apps, and developer infrastructure.

top_recommended_projects.name: SQL Chat
top_recommended_projects.summary: Multi-agent Streamlit application that translates natural language clinical queries to SQL, executes statistical tests, and returns interpretable Markdown summaries for researchers.

top_recommended_projects.name: Phenotype-Driven Rare Disease Prioritization Pipeline
top_recommended_projects.summary: End-to-end tertiary analysis pipeline for phenotype-based gene prioritization, variant selection, and clinical reporting in rare genetic disorders. Awarded Top Rank at Bangalore Tech Summit 2025.

talking_points: Tailored for BioTech AI's Lead Bioinformatics Scientist opening with focus on Lead Bioinformatics Scientist / Clinical Genomics.
Emphasize 10+ years of clinical & production bioinformatics and modern AI engineering.
Leverage relevant hands-on projects: SQL Chat, Phenotype-Driven Rare Disease Prioritization Pipeline.
